caption:
Most service businesses don't have a quality problem. They have a visibility problem.

You can be the best electrician, cleaner or mechanic in town. If people don't see your work, they book the guy who posts.

Post the before and after. Share the 5-star review. Tell people you have openings this week.

Nobody is going to sell your business for you.

Save this for the next time you feel weird about promoting yourself.
